A argonite lantern is an off-hand necromancy weapon available in Daemonheim.
It can be made using ensouled argonite bars at level 64 Smithing.

Ariane Robe Top.x: Ariane Robe Top is a torso slot cosmetic override. It is part of the Ariane set.

sc: The ice-dyed augmented Dark Shard of Leng is a level 95 Melee main hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Dark Shard of Leng (ice), or by using an ice dye on an augmented Dark Shard of Leng.
The avernic book is an item reward from the Demon Slayer quest.
Players who completed the quest before the item was added can speak to Gideon Bede in the Varrock church to obtain it.
A beer barrel flatpack can be made at a workbench (Wooden workbench or better) in the workshop of a player-owned house.

Bistromancer's Staff.x: The Bistromancer's Staff is a staff override that can be obtained by purchasing the RuneScape Teatime Max Pack or Starter Pack, available from 26 July 2021 to 11 January 2026.

A Casket (hard) was the item received when completing the final clue scroll of a hard clue scroll trail prior to the Clue Scroll Overhaul on 26 February 2018.
It contained the reward for the hard trails prior to this date.
The casket could be received from Treasure Trail NPCs, such as Uri, or by digging at a map spot or after completing a coordinate clue.
The challenger halo is an item awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that either get a 'world-first' broadcast, or by maintaining rank 100 overall or in any skill until the end of the competitive phase.
Chaos boots are an elemental pair of boots obtained at the end of the quest Elemental Workshop IV.

The card could be given by the gorajo hoardstalker found in the Gorajo Hoardstalker Dungeon (requiring level 95 Dungeoneering and completion of the quest Plague's End to enter) in Meilyr district in Prifddinas.

sc: The combat XP lamp is a reward for completing The Death of Chivalry.
The Croesus sporehammer is a drop from Croesus.

A D&D token (penguin hide and seek) is an item gained from the Squeal of Fortune, granting the player an extra round of Penguin Hide and Seek and its corresponding reward Penguin points which can be exchanged for either Coins or experience.
Though the Distractions and Diversions specific tokens are no longer obtainable in game, an item with a similar function known as a D&D token was later released.
The Darkmeyer trousers are made by fixing the ripped darkmeyer trousers with a needle and thread.

The defender's flamethrower is obtained by a defender role in the final wave of hard mode of Barbarian Assault after all players have deposited five of their roles required items (a defender requires obtaining five fuel sacs).
Once obtained players must chant from their scroll in the correct order to make the Penance King vulnerable to the flamethrower.
The dossier is obtained as Sir Amik Varze initially briefs the player in Black Knights' Fortress, which was replaced by The Death of Chivalry on 13 August 2013.
They can be purchased with 200 Fist of Guthix tokens from Fist of Guthix or with 100 thaler from Stanley Limelight's store.
Throughout the duration of the promotion, dune menders can be won on Treasure Hunter in varying amounts - with four available as a common prize and up to 16 available to be won as a rare prize.
The egg combination notebook is received from Kara.

Flourishing Fairy Petal Bottoms.x: The Flourishing Fairy Petal Bottoms are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Flourishing Fairy outfit.

sc: It is made by casting the Lvl-4 Enchant spell on a diamond bracelet, which can be made with the Crafting skill.

Forinthry Umbral Robes is a cosmetic override set that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be unlocked through Prime Gaming between 18 July and 15 August 2023.

Fresh potato.x: Fresh potatoes can be harvested from a Fresh Potato Plant during the 2020 Halloween event in Famine's miniquest. 120 of them are required to complete the miniquest.

The Gloves of Autumn are an item that can be purchased as part of Outfit of Autumn from the Seasons Store.
Originally, they could be made by combining 600 fallen leaves.

Godless ceremonial robe top.x: The Godless ceremonial robe top is an item that could be obtained by redeeming 500 Astromancer credits. Since 23 July 2018, it is available for free from Diango.

sc: Golden Saradomin godsword is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 1 golden cosmetic token from the Golden Goods shop.
Gorgonite ore can be found in the Sinkholes Distraction and Diversion.
It can only be obtained and used within Daemonheim.
It can be created at level 96 Fletching by stringing an unstrung grave creeper longbow with a bowstring.

Highland kilt (purple, male).x: The purple highland kilt is part of the highland outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: It can be purchased for 99,000 coins alongside the Smithing hood from Thurgo south of Port Sarim by players who have achieved level 99 Smithing.
A huge XP lamp (Prayer) is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter.

An initiate hauberk is the platebody piece of initiate armour that can be obtained from the Initiate Temple Knight Armoury or Proselyte Temple Knight Armoury run by Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador after completing the Recruitment Drive quest.
It can also be obtained by unpacking an initiate harness (f) or initiate harness (m).

Kalphite Emissary Gloves.x: The Kalphite Emissary Gloves are a hands slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Kalphite Emissary outfit.

sc: Khali brew is a beer that can be bought from Angor in the bar on the south west corner of the Fight Arena for 5 coins.
The Lamp of the Djinn is an experience lamp that can be obtained only once from the Squeal of Fortune.
The experience awarded by the lamp is 25% more than the experience awarded by a normal medium XP lamp.
The total experience given by the lamp ranges from 3906.

sc: The large skill training dummy crate is a crate won from Treasure Hunter or bought from Vic's Store.
Four dummies can be obtained from one crate and it is destroyed once four are taken.
They are found throughout the quest City of Senntisten.
Two are found in the cathedral when still preparing the dais with Azzanadra, and others are found through other parts of the city.
A magic potion is a one-dose potion only available in Daemonheim.
It is made by adding a clean wormwood leaf and void dust to a vial of water.
It can be created by combining 3,600 sentinel fragments.
It could be won from Treasure Hunter as a promotional prize on 11, 12, and 13 March 2017.
It is obtained by upgrading a small loot bag with 500 pilfer points at Dodgy Derek's Dirty Deals.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 mithril bars, requiring 800 progress to complete, granting a total of 240 Smithing experience.

q: Necromancy XP lamp (100000 Necromancy XP – requires level 75)
sc: Necromancy XP lamp is an item awarded for completion Requiem for a Dragon.
Like other treasure chests, they can be used to store most items obtained from Treasure Trails, with the oak treasure chest being able to store reward items from easy Treasure Trails.
To obtain this item, players must partake in smithing a ceremonial sword after randomly being given plans when they finish smithing an item in the Artisans' Workshop.
Although only members can smith this sword and it is untradeable, the wield option and the stats are available in free-to-play.
The ogre club is a common drop from ogresses, ogress warriors, and ogress champions, all of which may be found west of Oo'glog.
An oily cloth was created by using Sir Vant's oil can on the cloth during the Unstable Foundations tutorial.
Powder (copper sulphate) is used in A Void Dance quest to analyse the sample found on the Wood shards.
The profound decorative helm is a helmet that can be bought for 7475 thaler or as a reward from Lanthus for 650 gold Castle wars tickets and requires a defence level of 80 to wear.
They are obtained as a drop from a Tanglefoot.
Radiant Crusader Drake is a companion pet that can be claimed while having Premier Membership active from the game update on 13 November 2023.

Replica GWD (Torva) Platebody.x: The Replica GWD (Torva) Platebody is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Replica GWD (Torva) outfit.

sc: The Replica statue piece is an item rewarded for completing the Statue of Dahmaroc.
Replica statue pieces are obtained in a specific order, and each one resembles a normal strange rock.
A resource pack can be obtained as a reward for completing ten of Meg's cases during the Mega May event.
On 11 July 2016, the resource pack returned during the Port Sarim Invasion as a possible reward from the Supply cache (Port Sarim Invasion).
It can be made by using a piece of sacred clay class 5 on a creation kiln.
As with all sacred clay items, it can be traded freely between players who are on the same team during the minigame.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 8 rune bars and a rune full helm + 2, requiring 1,440 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,920 Smithing experience.
It should be opened to obtain the tokens within, which can be spent at Elof's rune item token exchange.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 4 rune bars and rune off hand claws + 1, requiring 1,200 progress to complete, granting a total of 960 Smithing experience.
The player must obtain four different notes for the quest by killing Skeletons, Dried zombies and Scabarites north of the archaeologist camp, or Mummies to the west.

Shadow Gem Helm is a cosmetic head override that can be claimed by redeeming a shadow gem helm token, which may be obtained either by playing Treasure Hunter throughout the duration of the second iteration of Crystal Capsules promotion or by purchasing it from the Grand Exchange.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Shadow Gem Staff, destroying the token in the process.
The shame filled key is an item dropped by Shame during Nomad's Elegy.
It is used to open the chest and obtain the Xenia memory half (Shame).

Superior void knight top is an upgraded version of the void knight top which can be made by using a Void knight armour patch on a void knight top.
